title: Programme roadmap
disclaimer: Website and communications milestones are not the same as clinical development progress. Statuses are qualitative only (completed, in_progress, planned, or not_confirmed). No completion percentages or funds raised.
intro: This page separates communication and website milestones from clinical development milestones for the planned Phase 2B CHR-P study. Completing public pages does not mean the clinical study has advanced.
schema_note: Optional milestone field track: communications | clinical. Statuses: completed | in_progress | planned | not_confirmed.

milestones.name: Public science resources live
milestones.purpose: Publish informational science, evidence, glossary and related pages for patients, families, clinicians and researchers.
milestones.evidence: Live pages on this site (Science, Evidence, Glossary and related)

milestones.name: Programme synopsis / Phase 2B overview published
milestones.purpose: Publish a public programme synopsis and Phase 2B overview describing the planned study at a high level.
milestones.evidence: Public synopsis and Phase 2B overview pages on this site

milestones.name: Investigational formulation described
milestones.purpose: Describe NWPT-SM32300 publicly as the investigational oral CBD micellar softgel candidate for the CHR-P programme.
milestones.evidence: Public product description on Science, Programme and public synopsis; investigational — effectiveness not established

milestones.name: Study preparation
milestones.purpose: Finalise operational design for the proposed Phase 2B study (sites, synopsis lock, budget and operational package).
milestones.evidence: Working public synopsis and planning materials; full operational finalisation ongoing

milestones.name: Applicable approvals
milestones.purpose: Obtain ethics, regulatory and other applicable approvals required before site activation.

milestones.name: Site activation
milestones.purpose: Contract and activate participating clinical sites under the approved protocol.
milestones.evidence: Depends on approvals and operational readiness

milestones.name: Recruitment
milestones.purpose: Enrol eligible participants into the Phase 2B study.
milestones.evidence: Follows site activation; this website is not an enrolment portal

milestones.name: Follow-up
milestones.purpose: Complete treatment and follow-up assessments per protocol (including week-16 follow-up in the working design).

milestones.name: Analysis
milestones.purpose: Analyse primary and secondary outcomes and report findings according to the statistical analysis plan.
